jobs.occupation: Chauffeur CE( kooiaap/ kraan/ Haakwagen/ plateauwagen)
jobs.description:
Do you hold a CE driving licence and and Code 95 ? Then you might be the person we are looking for!
 

In this role, you will deliver various materials with your truck (and unload them yourself) at construction sites or at customers’ premises.
 

 
• You transport goods correctly and safely to the customer.
 
• You load and unload the goods independently using your truck-mounted forklift.
 
• You work closely together with the transport planner.
 
• You communicate correctly and in a friendly manner with customers and ensure accurate administrative follow-up. 

 
• You hold a valid CE driving licence and Code 95.
 
• You can communicate fluently in Dutch, French, or English.
 
• You take care of the equipment you work with.
 
• You are a reliable driver with a strong focus on safety.
 
• You are polite and helpful towards customers.
 
• You remain calm and courteous in traffic.
 
• You are punctual, including with administrative tasks (CMRs, trip sheets, etc.).
 
• You are responsible and able to work independently.

We’re Looking for Technicians!
 

We’re recruiting for a company in 
Ruiselede that specializes in sustainable and energy-efficient installations.
 

Do you value sustainability? Do you want to make a meaningful impact on your community?
 

Then be sure to read on!
 

What will your responsibilities be?
 
 

• You’ll be responsible for installing charging stations, heat pumps, and solar panels 

• You’ll perform installation work 

• You’ll work on-site, departing from Ruiselede at 7:00 a.m. 

Who are you?

• You have experience in the construction industry
• You’re not afraid of heights
• You can handle a bit of wind (you’ll be working outdoors)
• You’re flexible, eager to learn, and honest
• You’re open to starting work under an IBO contract
• You have a Class B driver’s license and your own car
• You speak English or Dutch

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

A growing company that provides bespoke packaging and storage services for frozen and chilled food products for European customers. By 2027, the company aims to have over 300 employees working together on 25,000 unique packaging orders. You'll work in a respectful environment where teamwork and job satisfaction are key.

For a client in the Roeselare region, within the food sector, Let's Work is looking for an experienced forklift operator for day shifts.

Your main responsibilities will include the safe handling and storage of goods, operating the forklift to a height of up to 8 metres and ensuring a smooth flow of goods to the packaging department. On top of that, you can count on a starting wage of €15.23 per hour, meal vouchers worth €7 per day and attractive working hours from 8.00 am to 4.30 pm.

Are you looking for a great logistics job on the day shift? Be sure to read on!

What will you be handling as a forklift operator?

 
• 
You'll spend most of your day (±90%) operating the forklift

 
• 
You'll be placing octabins and pallets at heights of up to 8 metres in the warehouse

 
• 
You'll be responsible for delivering products to be packaged to the packaging department

 
• 
You scan labels and locations correctly into the system

 
• 
During your work, you ensure a smooth and organised flow of goods

 
• 
You hold a valid forklift certificate

 
• 
You have at least 2 years' experience as a forklift operator, including working at height

 
• 
You communicate fluently in English to work effectively with colleagues

 
• 
Working in a cold environment (deep-freeze), using a heated forklift truck, is in line with your expectations

 
• 
Working accurately and respecting safety are second nature to you

jobs.occupation: Administrative Assistant - Real Estate - Full Time or 4/5th
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international company managing an extensive real estate portfolio across Belgium.The company offers a stable environment, a collaborative culture and the opportunity to contribute to projects that have a tangible impact across the country. They are located in Diegem and easily accessible by car, tram, bus and train.

Jobomschrijving

• Support administration and follow-up of lease renewals, acquisitions and ongoing property files.
• Review contracts, interpret and gather relevant information.
• Manage correspondence and DocuSign signature processes.
• Ensure accurate filing and document management.
• Follow up with landlords regarding contractual and administrative matters.
• Support invoice processing and administrative reporting.
• Prepare reports, presentations and meeting documentation.
• Coordinate with various internal stakeholders and ensure proper follow-up of actions.

• A few years of experience in an administrative, coordination or property-related support role.
• Exposure to property management, lease administration, real estate, notary or similar environments is a strong asset.
• Proactive; organised and adaptable personality, able to support different stakeholders and managers.
• Professional level French and Dutch, with a good level of English.

The organisation is one of the leading companies in its field. Their offices are located in Diegem close to the train station. You'll join a dynamic and multicultural team in an entry-level position and a company that invests in the growth potential and the well-being of their employees.

Jobomschrijving

As an administrative assistant you'll be responsible for:

• Providing administrative support to paralegals and attorneys
• Managing calls, emails and mail with stakeholders
• Collecting and assessing accuracy of official documents and certificates
• Maintaining efficient filing system for all relevant documents
• Coordinating administration of ongoing projects

• Bachelor in administration, office management, languages or any related field
• Excellent level of French and English, Dutch is a plus
• Strong organisational and time management skills
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Detail oriented and excellent teamspirit

• Our client is a well-established Belgian industrial SME operating in the electrical equipment and energy infrastructure sector, delivering innovative solutions for power distribution and electrical installations.
• Combining the agility of a local entrepreneur-driven organization with an international business exposure, the company serves utility, infrastructure, and industrial customers across Belgium and European markets.

Jobomschrijving

• Develop and execute the commercial strategy for Medium Voltage and electrical distribution solutions in Belgium and BENELUX.
• Identify new business opportunities and build long-term relationships with key stakeholders including utilities, electrical contractors, engineering firms, panel builders, and industrial customers.
• Promote and develop the portfolio of Medium Voltage equipment and power distribution solutions.
• Act as a trusted technical advisor, supporting customers in product selection, applications, and industry requirements.
• Monitor market developments, industry trends, and competitive activities to identify growth opportunities.
• Collaborate closely with internal Sales, Engineering, Operations, and Management teams to drive business performance and support future business unit development.

• Master's degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Electromechanics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
• Proven experience in technical sales, business development, or BU management (P&L management) within the electrical distribution sector.
• Strong knowledge of Medium Voltage, Low Voltage, power distribution equipment, switchgear, MCCBs, RMUs, DSO or related electrical solutions.
• Commercially driven with the ability to build relationships and develop new business opportunities.
• Fluent in French and Dutch, with a professional command of English.

Jobomschrijving

This position offers an excellent opportunity to further develop your accounting expertise in a dynamic, multicultural, and collaborative environment.

Jobomschrijving

Our client is an international organization based in Zaventem, supporting operations across Europe in sectors such as automotive, industrial, energy, and materials.

As a Finance & Accounting Specialist, you will support day-to-day accounting activities, month-end closings, reporting processes, audits, and continuous improvement initiatives while working closely with colleagues across the business.

Your Responsibilities

Sales & Purchase Accounting
	
• Support the Sales Department with accounting treatment, SAP bookings, and invoice reviews.	
• Review outgoing invoices and maintain accounting procedures and manuals.	
• Expenses & Invoice Management	
• Process expense invoices and bank transactions in SAP.	
• Support internal users with SAP and invoice-related queries.	
• Review and process employee expense claims via SAP Concur.	
• Keep procedures up to date and contribute to process improvements and Kaizen initiatives.
General Accounting Support
	
• Assist with monthly closings and reporting.	
• Perform reconciliations, bank postings, account reviews, and follow-up on open items.	
• Support invoice booking and resolve accounting discrepancies.	
• Prepare documentation for audits 	
• Provide backup support for payments, banking, foreign exchange, and other finance-related activities.	
• Support the Accounting Manager with accruals, 

Your Profile
	
• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.	
• Approximately 2 to 3 years of relevant accounting experience.	
• Solid understanding of accounting principles and financial processes.	
• Experience working with SAP is a strong asset.	
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office, especially Excel.	
• Strong attention to detail and high level of accuracy.	
• Proactive, solution-oriented mindset with a continuous improvement attitude.	
• Able to work independently while being a strong team player.	
• Excellent communication skills and stakeholder management abilities.	
• Fluent in English, with a good knowledge of Dutch and French.

Our client is a global leader in integrated real estate and facility management services, supporting large corporate and industrial environments. The organisation delivers end-to-end technical, operational, and workplace solutions, with a strong focus on safety, innovation, digital tools, and sustainability.

Jobomschrijving

• Ensure high-quality, cost-efficient, and safe delivery of engineering and technical services across the site.
• Manage engineering service providers and suppliers in collaboration with procurement teams.
• Oversee infrastructure maintenance, utilities, and engineering operations, ensuring uninterrupted service delivery (24/7).
• Develop, maintain, and continuously improve Engineering SOPs, ensuring regular training and operational compliance.
• Support preventive maintenance programs using CMMS tools, ensuring data accuracy and asset reliability.
• Prepare and maintain long-term capital and infrastructure investment plans, aligned with site leadership priorities.
• Maintain clear ownership of critical systems (electrical, thermal, pressure systems, life safety).
• Support implementation of Health, Safety, Environment & Risk policies and ensure regulatory compliance.
• Contribute to technical delivery of capital projects and new technology deployments.
• Monitor and control engineering budgets, maintenance costs, and spare parts management.
• Identify and implement energy efficiency and cost-saving initiatives without compromising service quality.
• Ensure compliance with statutory, internal, and client-specific quality and safety standards.
• Actively participate in audits, governance meetings, and quality assurance programs.
• Foster a strong "One Team" culture across employees, contractors, and client stakeholders.

• Strong technical background in building services engineering (HVAC, electrical, mechanical systems).
• Proven experience in technical operations, facilities management, or engineering leadership roles.
• Excellent leadership, prioritisation, and conflict-resolution skills.
• Ability to analyse data, assess risk, and translate insights into practical actions.
• Experience working in critical or high-availability environments.
• Strong safety mindset with hands-on knowledge of HS&E frameworks.
• Fluent in English, with good knowledge of Dutch or French.
• Comfortable working with digital tools such as BMS, CMMS, ticketing, and financial systems.
• Results-driven, proactive, and resilient, with a continuous improvement mindset.

Our client is a leading player within the banking sector, recognized for its strong focus on risk management and sustainable growth. As an established financial institution, they offer a dynamic environment where expertise, innovation, and collaboration are key.

Jobomschrijving

• Assessing and analyzing credit applications
• Evaluating financial statements, cash flow, and overall creditworthiness of borrowers.
• Formulating recommendations and making credit decisions within delegated authorities.
• Monitoring and managing the existing credit portfolio, identifying potential risks early.
• Developing and enhancing credit risk models, frameworks, and policies.
• Collaborating with commercial teams to balance business growth and risk exposure.
• Implementing strategies to mitigate credit losses.
• Ensuring compliance with internal policies and external regulations 
• Reporting on risk exposure, trends, and key metrics to senior management.

• A Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Engineering, or a related field.
• Relevant experience in credit risk, credit analysis, or risk management within financial services or banking.
• Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret financial statements.
• Sound knowledge of credit risk models and regulatory frameworks 
• Strong decision-making skills and a proactive mindset.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
• Fluent in Dutch and/or French, good level of English.
• The ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

• Our client is a well-established real estate services firm specializing in property management, building operations, and technical asset optimization.
• The organization supports a portfolio of professional and commercial real estate assets with a strong focus on service quality, efficiency, and long-term client relationships.

Jobomschrijving

• Coordinate technical maintenance, including tendering, planning, and execution
• Manage service providers (maintenance, cleaning, security, etc.)
• Ensure compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations
• Prepare and evaluate supplier offers, contracts, and performance
• Monitor works execution to ensure quality and adherence to standards
• Respond proactively to technical issues and operational incidents
• Develop and manage preventive maintenance programs and budgets
• Review and validate invoices from contractors and suppliers
• Optimize space utilization and coordinate internal relocations
• Organize facility services using dedicated FM tools and systems

• Background in engineering, facilities management, or technical operations
• Prior experience in building management or real estate services
• Excellent organizational and prioritization skills
• Strong communication and stakeholder coordination abilities
• Autonomous, proactive, and solution-driven mindset
• Resilience under pressure and ability to manage multiple priorities
• Familiarity with MS Office; knowledge of CAD tools is an advantage
• Fluent in English and French for professional interactions

The client is a leading B2B company committed to delivering high-quality products and innovative solutions to customers across multiple industries. By combining technical expertise, customer focus, and operational excellence, they help our clients improve their performance and achieve their business objectives.

Their success is built on long-term partnerships, a collaborative culture, and a passion for delivering value. They continuously invest in innovation, sustainability, and the development of their people to stay ahead in a rapidly evolving market.

Joining their team means becoming part of a dynamic, entrepreneurial environment where initiative is encouraged, achievements are recognized, and career development is supported. They believe that their employees are their greatest asset and strive to create a workplace where everyone can grow, collaborate, and make a meaningful impact.

Jobomschrijving

They are looking for a proactive and customer-focused (Sr) Account Manager to join their growing commercial team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing and developing a portfolio of B2B customers, building long-term relationships, identifying growth opportunities, and ensuring an outstanding customer experience.

You will work closely with internal teams to deliver tailored solutions that meet clients' business needs while contributing to the company's commercial objectives.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage and develop a portfolio of existing B2B customers.
• Build strong, long-term relationships with key decision-makers.
• Identify opportunities to grow existing accounts through cross-selling and upselling.
• Prepare and present commercial proposals tailored to customer needs.
• Negotiate contracts and pricing within company guidelines.
• Coordinate with internal departments (Customer Service, Operations, Supply Chain, Marketing, Finance) to ensure seamless execution.
• Monitor customer satisfaction and proactively resolve issues.
• Analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitor activities.
• Maintain accurate records and sales forecasts using the CRM system.
• Achieve and exceed sales targets and KPIs.

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
• 3-7 years of experience in a B2B Account Management or Sales role.
• Proven ability to build and maintain strong client relationships.
• Strong commercial acumen with excellent negotiation skills.
• Customer-oriented mindset with a solution-driven approach.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills.
• Organized, autonomous, and results-driven.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
• Experience using CRM systems (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, HubSpot, or similar) is an asset.
• Fluent in French, DUtch and English

Our client is a recognised player in real estate advisory, specialising in supporting investors and corporates with strategic property transactions. With a solid reputation and deep market expertise, the company combines local market knowledge with a forward-looking investment approach, delivering tailored solutions across multiple asset classes.

Jobomschrijving

• Identify and originate new investment opportunities in the real estate market
• Build and manage a portfolio of investors and key stakeholders
• Develop financial models and investment cases for complex transactions
• Conduct market research, trend analysis, and due diligence
• Advise clients on transaction structuring and investment strategies
• Prepare high-quality presentations and investment memoranda
• Collaborate with internal teams to execute deals end-to-end
• Contribute to the growth and positioning of the business unit

• Relevant experience in finance, banking, real estate or investment advisory (3 to 8 years)
• Strong analytical and financial modeling capabilities
• Commercial mindset with a track record of business development or deal-making
• Excellent communication and presentation skills
• Ability to build relationships with senior-level stakeholders
• Proactive, ambitious, and results-driven personality
• Strong organisational and time management skills
• Bilingual Dutch and French, English is an asset

Our client is a globally admired design-driven company. They're based in the North of Brussels and looking for an AR Accountant to strengthen the team.

Jobomschrijving

• 2-3 years of experience in Accounting / Credit Control

Financial Controller ready to make an impact in a fast-paced and growing environment.
 

In this role, you act as a key link between finance and operations. You analyze financial performance, monitor the balance sheet, and provide clear insights and recommendations to management. You will also play an active role in improving processes and profitability.

Our client, based in Antwerp, is active in logistics. 

Jobomschrijving

As a Freight Forwarder export, you are responsible for coordinating and monitoring domestic and international shipments and serve as the point of contact for customers, carriers, and internal stakeholders.

Your main responsibilities:
	
• Organizing and coordinating shipments by road, rail, sea, and air	
• Operational monitoring of shipments (including sailings, railcars, and HSE)	
• Preparing and processing transport and shipping documents (including Bill of Lading, Letter of Instruction, Dispatch...)	
• Receiving and processing customs documents	
• Managing and updating transportation information and procedures (including in SharePoint)	
• Preparing and sending container and cargo manifests	
• Informing customers about costs, transit times, and shipment status	
• Ensuring accurate record-keeping and a smooth handoff within the team

Who are you?
	
• Minimum A2 diploma 	
• Minimum 2–5 years of relevant experience as a freight forwarder export or in a similar role	
• Strong operational knowledge of freight forwarding and logistics processes	
• Knowledge of transport documentation and IT systems	
• An IMDG certificate (dangerous goods) is a strong asset	
• Fluent in Dutch and English, both verbally and in writing	
• Meticulous, able to handle stress, customer-focused, and a strong communicator	
• Able to work independently and manage priorities

Do you enjoy precision shaping pipes and creating strong welds for technical installations? As a TIG or semi-automatic welder, you'll work on a variety of HVAC projects within the construction sector. You'll read plans, build custom installations, and weld pipes into perfect assemblies for heating and plumbing. Depending on the project, you'll work both on-site and in the workshop, preparing and assembling components. Thanks to the variety of high-end projects, your job remains technically challenging and educational. You'll be part of a large team where collaboration, quality, and safety are paramount.

What are your tasks?

• Reading and interpreting technical plans

• Bending, grinding, and welding pipes (TIG/semi-automatic)

• Preparing and assembling installations in the workshop and on-site

• Experience as a welder in a technical or construction environment

• Communicate in English or Romanian

• Possession of a driver's license
